title: Mouse waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 75 Q15 85 10 75 Q5 65 15 60' fill='none' stroke='#e8a0b0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#e0e4ec'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <path d='M32 62 Q24 68 26 74' fill='none' stroke='#b0b8c8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='75' r='4' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  <!-- right arm (waving up) -->
  <path d='M64 60 Q74 52 76 42' fill='none' stroke='#b0b8c8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='41' r='5' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  <!-- wave lines beside hand -->
  <path d='M84 36 Q88 34 86 30' fill='none' stroke='#7fd4a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M86 42 Q90 42 90 38' fill='none' stroke='#7fd4a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 45 Q85 47 83 50' fill='none' stroke='#7fd4a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='42' r='11' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='42' r='7' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='11' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='7' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='19' fill='#c8d0dc'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a40'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a40'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='54' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8607a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 58 Q48 62 52 58' fill='none' stroke='#7a5a70' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M34 52 L24 50' stroke='#a8b0c0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 55 L24 57' stroke='#a8b0c0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 52 L72 50' stroke='#a8b0c0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 55 L72 57' stroke='#a8b0c0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
